source.note: 1985 Topps Football. TCDB lists one 396-card base series. VCS includes the two pack-issued related checklists: Yearbooks Coming Soon Stickers and Glossy NFL Stars. Wax box-bottom material is excluded from normal pack pulls.

decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: The complete #1-396 flagship checklist is one Base ProductSet with equal VCS availability.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: TCDB's linked rookie index is the card-level source of truth. Only recognized Base rookie cards receive RC appended to Player. Insert/sticker cards do not receive RC merely because the pictured player may have a rookie card elsewhere.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean card subject name plus verified RC on recognized Base rookie cards. RB/AP/TL/UER/ERR/COR and other collector annotations stay outside Player.
decisions.oddsPlacement: Insertion odds are stored only on ProductSets. No card Variant receives insertion-odds text.
decisions.yearbookStickerModeling: Yearbooks Coming Soon Stickers are a 30-card insert checklist distributed one per wax pack, so VCS stores oddsPerPack 1.
decisions.glossyModeling: Glossy NFL Stars were one per 48-card regular rack pack. VCS uses one universal 15-card wax-style pack; card-volume normalization gives approximately one glossy per 3.2 VCS packs, stored as 1:3.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until images and pricing are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete flagship checklist #1-396, distributed in one series. All base cards have equal VCS availability.

productSets.name: Yearbooks Coming Soon Stickers
productSets.notes: 30-card sticker insert checklist, one sticker per wax pack. These are the Coming Soon-back versions distributed with 1985 Topps Football.

productSets.name: Glossy NFL Stars
productSets.notes: 11-card red-bordered glossy insert checklist. Originally one per 48-card regular rack pack; normalized by card volume to approximately 1:3 VCS 15-card packs.
